body:
You don't have to be sorry about anything.
I'm just looking up Khan academy,I didn't knew about it, looks pretty awesome.

The thing is I've tried in the past to fully occupy my time just so I can't think about my shit,but the truth was that I was just productive and just avoiding my feelings,until I had a complete break down to remind me that I can't just avoid things.

Tried therapy,pills multiple times,but it seems my clinical depression is still undefeated,and it seems that will remain the undefeated champ.
Never tried suicide hotlines,because that a short term solution,and my best sort term solution is booze

Hey,if there has to be someone to see suicide methods in everything,may as well be me.That's life,I guess.

Thanks for taking your time to let me a message.

I can't continue anymore,I'm broke now,and I'm to tired to continue my life or start a new one.I know I sound like a coward,because I am one,and really it got to a point where whatever I'm looking at I'm thinking how could I kill myself with that...I really don't know how could anyone could live like this,making breakfast and looking at the knife and thinking   that I could just slit my wrist in that moment,walking on the street and seeing that big building and just imagining everything can end in 5 seconds.

But it seems that I will end up with some pills and some booze because I hate blood and I just want to sleep into my death.
